measurements.basis: Same complete synthetic notebook and same two visible Morning tasks; baseline screenshot geometry verified separately.

limitations: All browser checks used headless Chromium on Linux, not physical phones/tablets, Safari, Firefox, a native mobile keyboard or a real kitchen pilot.
Touch/coarse-pointer input was emulated at tablet width. Hybrid physical input was not verified.
200% reflow used a 720×422 CSS viewport with deviceScaleFactor=2 to represent a 1440×844 display at 200%; native browser zoom and OS text enlargement were not exercised.
Deep preparation chains, long names, empty/loading/error reads, calendar configuration and uncertain creation saves were explicitly emulated; all writes in the creation fault case were intercepted.
Role switching and daily check/Ready/Undo scenarios used the real local API and synthetic local D1 data only. Local Owner was restored after roles.
Compiled Worker smoke used explicit synthetic identity headers on loopback; it verifies compiled rendering, not production authentication.
No production menu/data equality, production migration/cutover or production deployment is claimed.
